summary: Build practical observability skills with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, and OpenTelemetry. Train your team today.
lede: Observability uses metrics, logs, and traces to explain service behavior, while monitoring and logging help teams detect and investigate operational issues. The course is for SRE, DevOps, platform, cloud operations, and application-support professionals who need to improve service visibility and diagnose incidents with evidence. Learners practice defining SLIs and SLOs, tuning Prometheus alerts, specifying Grafana dashboards, correlating logs with traces, and documenting incident evidence for reliability reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to improve service visibility, reduce alert noise, and diagnose operational issues using telemetry.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of IT operations, cloud services, application support, or DevOps workflows. Familiarity with basic system metrics, log files, incident handling, and service dashboards is helpful. No coding/programming is required to complete the course, although prior exposure to command-line tools, cloud monitoring consoles, or scripting will make the exercises easier to apply. Advanced topics such as OpenTelemetry instrumentation and AI-assisted log analysis are taught at an operational application level, with a focus on configuration, interpretation, and use in real monitoring workflows.
